ambient_events: One of the lamp columns buzzes, thinks about it, and settles.
A rig backs onto the hardstanding, thinks better of it, and pulls off again.
Somebody has chalked a boat name and a tide on the hut door. Both are months old.
Somewhere out on the deck a chain runs out and stops.
description: Six bays of hardstanding marked out in yellow that hasn't been repainted since anyone can remember, a kerb on three sides, and a lamp column at each corner of the seaward end. The harbourmaster's hut sits in the corner nearest the water, a bolted steel cabin with one lit window and a sign that has kept its colour better than the paint on the ground. Meltwater Row is SOUTH; the pier is NORTH.
name: Jetty Yard
